input: scheduled: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products
task: Explore: new venture drawing-set-index (sheet index, set check and revision compare from a construction drawing set PDF)

errors.what: First single-sheet eval read 74.0% of sheet numbers: the PDF tokenizer copied from submittal-register (originally bank-statement-pdf-to-csv) skipped inline images by searching for the next 'EI', which occurs inside binary image data; Ghostscript-written sheets with 1,000+ inline hatch images lost their title blocks.
errors.fix: skipInlineImage: unfiltered images skipped by W*H*components*bpc, filtered ones to a whitespace-delimited EI; regression test added. The same tokenizer lives in submittal-register and bank-statement-pdf-to-csv and may carry the bug (not changed in this PR).

errors.what: git ls-tree -l on a blobless clone fetched every blob (minutes, background task stopped).

goal: Ship a construction-document tool with measured accuracy on real public drawing sets (owner direction: construction; depth over calculators).
notes: Idea: drawing-set-index, a free in-browser sheet index for construction drawing set PDFs (number, title, NCS discipline and sheet type), a set check (no number, duplicates, order within discipline, split discipline, cover drawing index vs sheets) and a text compare of two issues. Number found by a set-wide vote for the title block's number cell; title by size, boilerplate frequency, ruled cell borders (new: straight rules collected from the content stream), address and revision-row filters. Eval on public OpeningDesign GitHub PDFs (not stored; eval/fetch.sh): 123 single-sheet PDFs with filename truth, number 121/123 (98.4%), number+title 115/123 (93.5%), 3 misses are filename errors verified with pdftotext; 14 whole sets / 180 pages: number on 172/172 text pages, 25/25 against filename truth. Found a real duplicate A501 in a public set. Verified: node --test engine.test.mjs page.test.mjs (15 pass), page driven in Chromium (sample + 25-sheet set, no console errors, 390 px no horizontal scroll), run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes (sibling-links failed once, fixed by a reciprocal link from submittal-register). Next if it pays off: other offices' sets (AutoCAD, public bid sets), revision table vs changed sheets, linework signature, slip-sheeting a combined PDF.
